question: How much does the Grove plan cost per member each month?
reference: The Grove plan costs $12 per member per month when billed monthly.
reference_contexts:
Plans and prices

Sableboard has three plans. The Sprout plan is free and includes 3 members and 2 projects. The Grove plan costs $12 per member per month when billed monthly. The Grove plan costs $120 per member per year when billed yearly. The Canopy plan costs $28 per member per month when billed monthly. The Canopy plan costs $280 per member per year when billed yearly. Canopy includes SSO and an audit log. Sprout does not include SSO.

question: Does the Grove trial require a credit card?
reference: The Grove trial does not require a card.
reference_contexts:
Grove trial

A new workspace can start one Grove trial. The Grove trial is 14 days long. The Grove trial does not require a card. When the Grove trial ends, the workspace moves to the Sprout plan unless an admin chooses Grove or Canopy. A workspace can use the Grove trial only once.

question: Where do I download a past invoice?
reference: Workspace admins download a past invoice from Settings → Billing.
reference_contexts:
Invoices

Workspace admins download a past invoice from Settings → Billing. Each invoice lists the plan, the seat count, the tax, and the total charged. Invoices are PDF files. The invoice page is the place to read an invoice number for the signed-in workspace. Chat does not open that page for you.

question: Can I pay Sableboard with ACH?
reference: Sableboard accepts card payments and ACH payments.
reference_contexts:
Payment methods

Sableboard accepts card payments and ACH payments. ACH is available on Grove and Canopy for workspaces billed in US dollars. Sprout has no payment method because Sprout is free. Card payments can use Visa, Mastercard, or American Express. The workspace admin adds the payment method under Settings → Billing.

question: How long after a failed payment is the workspace downgraded?
reference: The workspace stays on its paid plan for 10 days after the failed payment.
reference_contexts:
Failed payments

If a renewal charge fails, Sableboard emails the workspace admin the same day. The workspace stays on its paid plan for 10 days after the failed payment. After those 10 days the workspace is downgraded to Sprout. Updating the card under Settings → Billing retries the charge. Sableboard does not charge a late fee during those 10 days.

question: If I add a seat in the middle of a monthly term, how is it billed?
reference: The new seat is prorated for the remaining days.
reference_contexts:
Seats and plan changes

If an admin adds a seat in the middle of a monthly term, the new seat is prorated for the remaining days. Removing a seat on a monthly plan takes effect at the next renewal, not immediately. Switching from Grove to Canopy starts a new term and charges the price difference. Switching from Canopy to Grove starts at the next renewal.

question: Does Sableboard charge VAT on Grove invoices for EU customers?
reference: Sableboard charges VAT on Grove and Canopy invoices for customers whose billing country is in the EU.
reference_contexts:
Taxes and VAT

Sableboard charges VAT on Grove and Canopy invoices for customers whose billing country is in the EU. The VAT rate follows the billing country on the invoice. US sales tax is added when the billing state requires it. Tax lines are shown on the PDF invoice. Sableboard chat does not prepare a tax return.
presence_phrase: charges VAT on Grove and Canopy

question: How long is the refund window for an annual plan purchase?
reference: Annual plan purchases can be refunded in full within 14 days of the initial charge.
reference_contexts:
Refund policy

Annual plan purchases can be refunded in full within 14 days of the initial charge. The annual refund also requires the workspace to have created fewer than 3 projects. After 14 days, annual plans are not refunded. A renewal has its own 14-day refund window starting on the renewal date. Monthly plans have no refunds for a partial month. Add-on storage is not refunded. I can't promise a refund that is not written in the refund policy. A human billing specialist decides any exception, and the specialist can say no.

question: If I cancel a monthly plan, do I keep access until the period ends?
reference: If you cancel a monthly plan, you keep access until the period ends.
reference_contexts:
Cancellation

The workspace admin cancels a paid plan under Settings → Billing. If you cancel a monthly plan, you keep access until the period ends. If you cancel an annual plan, you keep access until the period ends unless a refund was approved under the refund policy. Cancellation does not delete projects. Deleting the workspace is a separate step.

question: What email do I use to create a Sableboard workspace?
reference: Create a Sableboard workspace with a work email and a password of at least 12 characters.
reference_contexts:
Create an account

Create a Sableboard workspace with a work email and a password of at least 12 characters. The first person to create the workspace becomes the owner. A confirmation link arrives at that work email and expires in 24 hours. Personal email domains are allowed. The sign-up form still labels the address as a work email.

question: How do I reset my own Sableboard password?
reference: To reset your own Sableboard password, open the sign-in page, choose Reset password, and use the emailed link within 30 minutes.
reference_contexts:
Password reset

To reset your own Sableboard password, open the sign-in page, choose Reset password, and use the emailed link within 30 minutes. The link goes to the address on the account. After a self-serve reset, other sessions are signed out. Chat will not choose the new password.

question: What authenticator method does Sableboard two-factor use?
reference: Sableboard two-factor authentication uses TOTP.
reference_contexts:
Two-factor authentication

Sableboard two-factor authentication uses TOTP. You can enroll with any TOTP authenticator app. Backup codes are shown once at enrollment, and chat cannot show them again. Store the backup codes in a password manager. Losing both the authenticator and the backup codes requires the security desk to verify identity outside this chat.

question: Who can invite a new member to a workspace?
reference: A workspace admin can invite a new member.
reference_contexts:
Roles and invites

A workspace admin can invite a new member. The owner can also invite a new member. Members cannot send invites. Guests can see only the projects shared with them. An invite expires after 7 days. Pending invites are listed under Settings → Members.

question: How long does a workspace export link stay valid?
reference: The export link stays valid for 7 days.
reference_contexts:
Data export

A workspace admin can export projects as CSV and JSON. Sableboard emails the export link within 1 hour. The export link stays valid for 7 days. Guests cannot start an export. The export includes cards, comments, and attachment names, not the attachment bytes.

question: Which desktop version should I install if sync is stuck?
reference: If desktop sync is stuck, install Sableboard desktop version 4.2 or newer.
reference_contexts:
Desktop sync

If desktop sync is stuck, install Sableboard desktop version 4.2 or newer. Then sign out of the desktop app and sign in again. You can also check the status page before reinstalling. The local cache folder is named SableboardCache in the user home directory. Quit the desktop app before deleting that cache folder.

question: Mobile push notifications are missing. What should I check first?
reference: If mobile push notifications are missing, check the phone notification permission for the Sableboard app first.
reference_contexts:
Mobile notifications

If mobile push notifications are missing, check the phone notification permission for the Sableboard app first. Then turn on the in-app push toggle under Settings → Notifications. Quiet hours in the app can hide pushes from 10pm to 7am local time. Reinstalling the app is not the first step.

question: What is the attachment size limit on the Grove plan?
reference: The attachment size limit on the Grove plan is 25 MB.
reference_contexts:
Attachments

The attachment size limit on the Sprout plan is 5 MB. The attachment size limit on the Grove plan is 25 MB. The attachment size limit on the Canopy plan is 100 MB. Files over the limit are rejected before upload. Supported types include PNG, JPG, PDF, and TXT.

question: Where do I check whether Sableboard has an outage?
reference: Check whether Sableboard has an outage at status.sableboard.example.
reference_contexts:
Outages

Check whether Sableboard has an outage at status.sableboard.example. The status page lists desktop, mobile, and billing separately. If the status page says operational, the problem is likely local. Chat does not open an incident. Postmortems are linked from the same status page after a major outage.

question: Who can delete a Sableboard workspace?
reference: Only the workspace owner can delete a Sableboard workspace.
reference_contexts:
Workspace deletion

Only the workspace owner can delete a Sableboard workspace. Deletion stays reversible for 14 days from the deletion email. During those 14 days the owner can restore the workspace from that email. Members cannot delete a workspace. Export the cards before deleting if you still need them.
